reason: The case needs the keys of a Redis cache to be listed (SCAN, every key under the prefix t:{tenant_id}:) and the metric BI-MET-001 to be read as GET /api/v1/metrics/BI-MET-001/query. The stack has no Redis: its caches (AuthzCache, EntitlementCache, the ledger and summary caches under apps/api/src/modules) are Map objects inside the API process, so no test process can list their keys, and the API has no such route for a metric (the BI query is POST /dashboard-queries over certified dashboard versions). Only the theme of tenant B after a publish of tenant A could be proved, and a case proved in part is not proved; the theme isolation is covered by TC-TH01.
needs: A Redis (or a cache adapter whose keys a test can list) in the staging stack, and the metric query route with BI-MET-001 seeded with 1,000,000,000 VND for tenant A and 2,000,000,000 VND for tenant B

A case proved in part is not proved.
needs: A route (or a test port) that runs the vector retrieval with top-k for the caller's token, the knowledge collection of both tenants indexed with the embeddings created, and the documents with the same title and different content in tenants A and B
